references.name: 실화/사연형 - 분노 강조
references.description: Top 2-line bold hook with alternating yellow, green, and red emphasis over a subject-right dramatic layout.
references.grammarSummary: Two-line top headline with black-weight text, multiple highlight colors, and a right-weighted close-up composition.

grammarHints.layout: Use a full-width headline block across the top and keep the subject dominant on the right side.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: One large face close-up should anchor the right third of the frame.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Line 1 delivers the emotional trigger, line 2 adds the cause or consequence.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Use background or prop clues that explain conflict without reusing the sample identity.

textStyle.colorRule: Each keyword phrase gets a different highlight color. Primary words = yellow, secondary = green, emotional climax = red
textStyle.fontSize: very large, covering 30-40% of image width

references.name: 실화/사연형 - 슬픔 강조
references.description: Top 2-line hook with white base text, a single red emotional accent, and centered portrait framing.
references.grammarSummary: Centered portrait with a two-line headline at the top and one selective red emphasis point.

grammarHints.layout: Keep the text across the top and preserve a centered emotional portrait below it.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: A single close-up face should remain centered and fill most of the frame.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Use one calm setup line and one emotionally heightened payoff line.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Support the mood with domestic or intimate context rather than copying the sample room.

textStyle.colorRule: Most text in white, one key emotional phrase highlighted in red for emphasis
textStyle.fontSize: very large, covering 30-40% of image width

references.name: 판타지/모험형 - 수채화
references.description: Vertical left text with a light auxiliary bubble and a right-side hero in watercolor illustration.
references.grammarSummary: Three-line vertical headline on the left, airy negative space, and a right-side illustrated protagonist.

grammarHints.layout: Stack the main hook vertically along the left side and leave breathing room around the hero.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: A single stylized hero should occupy the right half with clear silhouette separation.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Split the hook into short stacked beats rather than long horizontal sentences.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Use fantasy props or weather cues that fit the scenario, not the sample explorer identity.

textStyle.colorRule: All main text in white. Optional gray speech bubble with sub-text at top-right corner
textStyle.outlineColor: soft dark outline, lighter than dramatic styles
textStyle.fontSize: large vertical text, each character stacked

references.name: 직장/사회형 - 갈등 강조
references.description: Bottom 2-line conflict hook with yellow and pink accents over a crowded workplace composition.
references.grammarSummary: Bottom-heavy text block with color-coded conflict keywords and a multi-person tension layout.

grammarHints.layout: Reserve the bottom band for the main hook and keep the character tension visible above it.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: Use two or more readable figures with one dominant focal reaction.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Lead with the conflict trigger and end with the emotional or social consequence.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Use props, posture, or location clues that explain workplace stakes without copying the sample room.

textStyle.colorRule: Base text in white, action words highlighted in yellow, emotional/conflict words in hot pink
textStyle.fontSize: very large, covering 30-40% of image width

references.name: 자기계발형 - 비포/애프터
references.description: Bottom 2-line before/after hook with split composition and a red-to-white problem/solution color contrast.
references.grammarSummary: Split-screen transformation layout with contrasting problem and solution zones plus a bottom caption band.

grammarHints.layout: Separate the frame into clear before and after halves, then anchor the hook at the bottom.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: Balance both sides evenly so the transformation is readable at a glance.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Use one negative phrase versus one positive phrase to create instant contrast.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Show visual change through posture, props, or environment rather than copying the sample character.

textStyle.colorRule: Problem/negative keywords in red, solution/positive keywords in white. Creates visual contrast between failure and success

references.name: 경제/재테크형 - 긍정 강조
references.description: Top-and-bottom informational hook with white base text plus green and yellow financial emphasis.
references.grammarSummary: Three-line finance-friendly layout with one short top hook, a supporting lower block, and central infographic character weight.

grammarHints.layout: Place a short headline at the top and two supporting lines near the bottom around a central figure.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: A simple central figure should support the message without overpowering the text.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Open with a big promise or result, then add detail lines below it.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Use charts, currency cues, or growth signals that match the scenario instead of copying the sample icons.

textStyle.colorRule: Base text in white with black outline. Key money/amount words in yellow. Growth/positive words in green. Top line = main hook, bottom lines = supporting detail

references.name: 뉴스/이슈형 - 놀라움 강조
references.description: Bottom 2-line surprise hook with a red first line, white second line, and centered reaction character.
references.grammarSummary: Urgent two-line news layout with strong red headline emphasis and a centered reaction focal point.

grammarHints.layout: Use a bottom caption band with the main shock statement first and context second.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: A central reaction figure should remain readable even with strong background symbols.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Lead with the shocking statement in red, then clarify the context in white.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Support the issue with topical symbols or skyline cues that fit the script instead of copying the sample country.

textStyle.colorRule: First line (shocking/attention phrase) in RED. Second line (detail/context) in WHITE. Creates urgency hierarchy

references.name: 경제/투자형 - 인포그래픽
references.description: Single-line top headline with data-driven infographic layout, yellow and red numeric emphasis, and structured supporting visuals.
references.grammarSummary: Top headline plus structured infographic field with highlighted numbers and supporting data labels.

grammarHints.layout: Keep one strong headline at the top and organize the remaining space into clean data blocks or timeline cues.
grammarHints.subjectWeight: Data graphics should carry most of the frame, with any character treated as a secondary support.
grammarHints.hookStructure: Focus the hook on one key claim or number, then let the infographic reinforce it.
grammarHints.evidencePattern: Use charts, labels, and icons that match the script topic rather than reproducing the sample sequence.

textStyle.colorRule: Main headline in white. Key numbers/amounts highlighted in yellow. Extreme values (like 10x) in red. Data labels in smaller white text throughout the infographic
textStyle.fontSize: main headline large, data labels medium-small
